items.summary_1line: Web agents increasingly edit images by calling open editing models in a critique-and-retry loop, and these models differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. After every rejected edit, a service must decide whe...

items.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
items.summary_1line: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. This long-term drif...
items.editor_note: Shifts focus to cumulative visual drift across repeated edits.

editorial.tldr: Papers began treating image editing as a serving problem: EditJev routed each request across editing models because per-sample quality varies widely. MoI-Bench then benchmarked on-device editing, and RetryRoute added cost-aware routing for critique-and-retry loops.
editorial.whats_new: TailSteer (Nov 4) targets multi-turn editing, where small unintended changes accumulate into visual drift even when single-turn quality is strong.
editorial.why_it_matters: Editing models differ in cost by over an order of magnitude and in per-sample quality, so routing, retry policy and multi-turn drift become reliability and cost levers for any service that edits images.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you run an edit-and-retry loop, log per-model reject rates and cost per accepted edit now, and cap multi-turn chains or re-anchor to the original image until drift fixes are independently verified.

beats.headline: Per-sample variation motivates routing across editing models
MoI-Bench measures image generation and editing on mobile hardware
RetryRoute makes routing retry-aware for agentic editing services
TailSteer attacks drift in multi-turn editing

open_questions: Do any of these routing or steering methods get reproduced on independent editing benchmarks?
Will MoI-Bench results show on-device models closing the gap with server-side editors?
Does TailSteer's drift reduction hold across editing models beyond those it tested?
